title: Pure Ritual Beast
summary: Ritual Beast cards only, with generic staples. A Ritual Beast Tamer and a Spiritual Beast banish themselves to become a Contact Fusion Ritual Beast Ulti, and the Ultis return to the Extra Deck on either turn to bring both halves back from banishment.

summary.title: Starters
points: Spiritual Beast Tamer Lara discards itself for an extra Ritual Beast Normal Summon and, when banished, Special Summons a Ritual Beast with a different name from the Deck.
Ritual Beast Tamer Elder grants an extra Ritual Beast Normal Summon the turn it is Normal Summoned, pairing immediately with Spiritual Beast Cannahawk or Spiritual Beast Rampengu.
Ritual Beast Inheritance reveals a Ritual Beast in your hand to search one of a different Type, then discards a card.
Ritual Beast Tamer Wen revives a banished Ritual Beast on Normal Summon, and Ritual Beast Tamer Lara revives one from the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Spiritual Beast Tamer Lara + Spiritual Beast Cannahawk
steps: Discard Spiritual Beast Tamer Lara for an extra Normal Summon, Normal Summon Spiritual Beast Cannahawk, and banish a Ritual Beast from the Deck; or banish Spiritual Beast Tamer Lara to summon a second Ritual Beast from the Deck.

Contact Fuse a Tamer and a Spiritual Beast into Ritual Beast Ulti-Cannahawk, return two banished Ritual Beasts to the GY to search a Ritual Beast card, and chain Ulti-Cannahawk's Quick Effect to summon a banished Tamer and Spiritual Beast.
Climb through Ritual Beast Ulti-Kimunfalcos and Ritual Beast Ulti-Nochiudrago into Link-4 Ritual Beast Ulti-Reirautari while setting Ritual Beast Steeds and Ritual Beast Ambush.

summary.title: Once-Per-Turn Special Summon Rule
summary.text: Each Main Deck Ritual Beast monster can only be Special Summoned once per turn. Because of that cap, the deck leans on extra Normal Summons from Ritual Beast Tamer Elder, Spiritual Beast Tamer Lara, Ritual Beast Ulti-Kimunfalcos, and Ritual Beast Ulti-Reirautari, while tracking which Tamer and Spiritual Beast names have not yet been Special Summoned from banishment.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: Ritual Beast Ulti-Reirautari stops both players from Tributing cards to activate effects, recycles a banished Ritual Beast to Normal Summon it, and banishes cards on the opponent's turn to banish a card they control.
Ritual Beast Ulti-Nochiudrago keeps your other Ritual Beasts from being targeted by opponent's card effects and tags out from the GY to summon a banished Ritual Beast.

Ritual Beast Ulti-Gaiapelio negates Monster, Spell, and Trap activations by banishing a Ritual Beast card from the hand, while Ulti-Pettlephin bounces monsters and Ulti-Apelio attacks unaffected by other card effects.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Ritual Beast Steeds destroys monsters up to the number of Ritual Beast monsters you control, which increases when you chain an Ulti's Quick Effect to split into two monsters.
Ritual Beast Ambush Special Summons a Tamer and a Spiritual Beast from the GY or banishment on either turn.
Ritual Beast's Bond and Ritual Beast Return provide Quick-Play Contact Fusions and banish-to-revive extension.
